author: mgallagher56
body:
## What
Fixes B1 from the verify-bank-sync model. A sync refused with AUTH_EXPIRED no longer writes `needs_reconnect` over a reconnect that landed during it. The write is now a compare-and-swap on the token ciphertexts the verdict was about (`recordNeedsReconnect`). On a miss nothing is written and the user is asked to try again.

Includes #903's skill commit, so this PR replaces it (no stacking).

## Why
Stale sync, wrong status and a confusing 409 before bank connections return (D11).

## Tests
4 new real-Postgres tests (fetch path, refresh path, plus no-reconnect and re-encrypted controls). The 2 race tests failed before the fix. check.sh passes: `current` includes `NeedsReconnectOnlyWhenTokenDead` and `broken-status-no-cas` fails without the CAS.

## Review
Opus security review: no findings above low. Opus code review: no bugs. Follow-up noted: the `error` status write is still unconditional.
